thread:
Maya Liao: Quick scrub — sprint demo prep for Console observability next Wed. Need a short status on dashboards, tracing hooks, error-analysis views, and the retention milestone. Who's owning which bits? Any hard blockers (runtime, ingest, or release)? cc @Eli Turner @Samir Patel @Jorie (eng-platform)

Eli Turner: I'm owning tracing hooks. Basic hooks wired in dev, PR #4823 is open but blocked on the runtime lib bump. ETA Wed AM if the runtime patch lands. :thumbsup:

Samir Patel: Dashboards — final layout done, pushing panel refs in PR #4890. Still waiting on ingest-team for per-route error-rate metrics. For demo we can either use the real feed or synthetic series. Retention suggestion: traces=30d, metrics=90d — want sign-off.

Jorie (eng-platform): Error-analysis views prototype ready, needs UX polish and links from dashboards. I can own rollout to staging once the tracing hooks are in. Also flag: do we want enterprise retention (60/180) or the default Samir suggested?

ingest-bot: ingestsvc deploy queued for 2025-11-03 02:00 UTC. (automated)

Maya Liao: Runtime bump is the critical path for tracing. Eli — what exact runtime change do you need? Samir — can you stub metrics for demo if ingest team is delayed?

Eli Turner: Need header propagation and KV cache passthrough in runtime v0.7.2. Minimal change: 
```diff
+ propagate_headers(ctx)
```
If eng-runtime can land by EOD tomorrow we can canary on staging and be green for demo.

Samir Patel: Yes, we can stub with a synthetic metric series named `console.demo_route_error_rate` for the demo dashboards until ingest is live. I'll add the stub and note in PR #4890.

Jorie (eng-platform): Can SRE own the canary? @Alex (eng-sre) assigning to you — need a simple two-node canary covering traces + dashboard links. Playbook: monitor `error_rate`, `p50_latency`, and token-cost. Alex, can you confirm?

Alex (eng-sre): I can take the canary. Canary policy I'll set: 10% traffic, 2h burn-in, rollback if >3% spike in error_rate or >20ms regression in p50. I'll post a runbook and the canary config later today.

Maya Liao: Ownership summary so far — Tracing hooks: Eli; Dashboards: Samir; Error views: Jorie; Canary: Alex/SRE. Dependencies: eng-runtime patch (Eli) and ingest metrics (ingest-team). Action items: Eli land runtime patch by EOD tomorrow; Samir add synthetic metric; Alex create canary; Jorie prep staging rollout and UX polish. Please react with :white_check_mark: when you have your items in flight.

Samir Patel: :white_check_mark: adding metric stub and updating PR.

Eli Turner: :white_check_mark: working on runtime PR #4823, pushing CI now.

Alex (eng-sre): I'll post the canary runbook at ts 1766004000.

ingest-team: We'll prioritize the metrics feed for demo. ETA Tue 17:00 UTC for the route error-rate.

Jorie (eng-platform): I'll preview the error-analysis views in staging Tue evening and link to the demo dashboard.

Maya Liao: Great — plan to do a short async check in this thread Tue 18:00 UTC to confirm everything is green before the demo. Thanks all!
